composition.focal_point: two anthropomorphic bagels facing each other
composition.balance: symmetrical but animated by opposing poses

layout.spacing: characters close enough to interact; generous separation from wordmark

color.contrast: solid black fills with white internal cutouts

typography.font_character: loose narrow hand-lettering with uneven baseline and mixed scale

shape_language.geometry: rounded organic bagel bodies, chunky shoes and clothing details
shape_language.radius: soft curves with occasional jagged cartoon accents
shape_language.line_quality: bold black contour with thin interior detail lines

surfaces.texture: minimal; visual texture comes from dots, hatch marks, and cutouts

imagery.subject: two dressed anthropomorphic bagels, one gesturing toward the other

motion_cues.suggested_behavior: gesture and opposing stance imply conversation

design_system: bold silhouette with delicate hand-lettered support
implementation_hints: draw as vector paths with variable stroke weights
use white knockouts inside black shapes
keep characters readable without internal details
likely_rules: every character detail should reinforce personality
wordmark should feel drawn by hand rather than typeset

style_dna.summary: A monochrome mascot logo built from two expressive, dressed bagel characters, using bold silhouettes, white cutout details, and a loose hand-lettered wordmark for a friendly neighborhood-food personality.
signature_traits: bold contour with small interior marks

unresolved_questions: Exact original lettering and whether the characters are intended as a full brand system are unknown.
